identity: A light open jacket worn unbuttoned over a top, hanging open down the front and reaching past the hip. Each front panel's shoulder and outer seam are the wearer's own shoulder-arc and side curves, so the seams sit right no matter the body; the open front edge and short cap sleeves are free-drawn.

regions.note: left front panel. 0 free hem, 1 fits torso.side_left reversed (hem up to shoulder), 2 fits torso.shoulder_arc_left reversed (shoulder to collar), 3-4 free open front edge back down to the hem. "over": ["leg_near"] matches the shirt/pants draw rank so the jacket shows over them.
right front panel, mirror of the left. 0 free hem, 1 fits torso.side_right reversed, 2 fits torso.shoulder_arc_right, 3-4 free open front edge.
far cap sleeve. 0 fits arm_far.arm_far_top (the shoulder dome); 1-2 free cuff.
near cap sleeve, mirror of the far one.
